scripts.title: Treadmill Distance Corrector
scripts.summary: Correct treadmill distance and pace in Intervals.icu, with FIT verification and original-file recovery.
instructions: Edit total distance or steady-speed stages on a Virtual Run.
Corrections preserve the activity ID, intervals and custom fields. The original FIT is retained for recovery.

scripts.title: Pomelo to Fitatu
scripts.summary: Copy Pomelo meals, nutrition and ingredients to the matching Fitatu diary date.
instructions: Select one or more Pomelo meals to import. Existing diary entries are checked to avoid duplicates.
The panel starts minimized and follows the selected date in each app.

Before sending, the five loaded meals are summed and compared with Pomelo’s menu summary for kcal, protein, carbs and fat. Each value is rounded to Pomelo’s displayed precision, allowing one displayed step in either direction (0.1 kcal or g when one decimal is shown). Larger differences or missing totals block sending.
If sending is blocked, expand the panel to see Pomelo and list values, then use Refresh. The Fitatu processing tab also requires matching totals evidence before writing.
Ticked days (Menu zostało wybrane) load automatically. Default days (Wybierz menu / fork-and-spoon) stay unloaded on day changes; expand the panel and use Refresh to load them manually.

scripts.title: Nutrition Balance
scripts.summary: Show daily calorie balance, weekly calorie and macro averages, and real versus predicted weight change in the Intervals.icu calendar.
instructions: Daily balance is intake minus a base of 2,400 kcal and recorded activity calories. To change the base, open the Tampermonkey menu on Intervals.icu and choose Set base calories. It is saved separately in each browser.
Weekly averages exclude missing values and future days. Explicit zero values are included.
The scale-icon value is the change in 14-day average weight from the previous Sunday to the week's end, or to today in the current week. It needs 8 readings in each 14-day window.
The kg value in brackets after the calorie balance is the change predicted from net calories at 7,700 kcal/kg, delayed the same way as the average. It needs 70% of those days logged.
The script reads the loaded calendar without editing your records.

scripts.title: Liftosaur Details
scripts.summary: Show Liftosaur sets in Intervals.icu and sync workout volume and volume-weighted RPE.
instructions: The Liftosaur tab shows completed sets, targets, volume and estimated one-rep maximums.
Workouts are automatically matched within two hours. Manual selections are preserved.
Background sync fills native Weight Lifted and RPE for historical workouts, preserving different manual values.
The initial sync notice dismisses after two seconds and stays quiet on later automatic view changes. Full sync status remains in Settings. An explicit Refresh all can show another brief notice.

scripts.title: YouTube Watch Later Sort
scripts.summary: Sort your YouTube Watch Later playlist from shortest to longest video and save the order.
instructions: Open Watch Later while signed in and click Sort by length below Play all. The list is sorted straight away, with no confirmation, and the page reloads to show it.
The new order is saved to your account and replaces the old one, which can't be restored. Videos without a length, such as live streams, go last.
New videos join the list wherever YouTube puts them. Sort again to place them. If a sort is stopped or fails, sorting again finishes the job.

The script uses YouTube's private interface with your signed-in session, on youtube.com only. YouTube can change that interface at any time; if it does, the script stops before moving anything where it can detect the change.
